question: One of the following statements is false in relation to the pharmacological effects of growth hormone:

options.opa: Acts directly on adipocytes to increase lipogenesis.
options.opb: Stimulates the longitudinal growth of the bones.
options.opc: It has anti-insulin actions in the liver.
options.ope: Many effects of growth hormone are due to insulin-like growth factor-1 (IGF-1).
